describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, standing on a flat surface. Its overall body shape, fur, head, and limbs resemble a brown bear, covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the back and legs and creamy off-white on the chest, throat and underside. Embedded in the fur are multiple glossy, hard-looking dark reddish-brown to black plates resembling beetle exoskeleton, distributed along the back, flank, shoulder, neck, and leg joints. A single large glossy black curved horn with small tines projects upward from the forehead. The animal stands on four thick legs ending in clawed paws, with a very short stubby tail at the rear.

describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature with the overall shape, fur, head and paws of a brown bear, shown in side view walking to the right. Its thick shaggy fur is dark brown on the back and legs and paler cream-brown on the belly and chest, with a short stub tail, two small rounded ears, a long bear muzzle with a black nose, and broad clawed paws. Fused into the fur are multiple glossy dark brown to black beetle-like exoskeleton structures, including a large ridged wing-case on the flank, a large shield over the shoulder and neck, smaller triangular plates on the back, rump and throat, and jointed bands around the upper legs and ankles, plus rows of small dark oval openings in the fur along the side and throat. A single long curved glossy black beetle horn with inner teeth and a forked tip rises from the forehead.
